Name: (CP) T's Sleeping Bag
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[center][b][size=5]T's Sleeping Bag[/size][/b]
Portable sleeping bags that let you sleep away from home.[/center]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]About[/b][/size][/color]
T's Sleeping Bag adds two craftable and purchasable sleeping bags that can be placed both indoors and outdoors.
Place a sleeping bag wherever you want to rest, interact with it, and you can sleep there just like using a temporary bed.
Two different models are available:

[color=#ffff00][b]Sleeping Bag (Budget Model)[/b][/color]
An inexpensive sleeping bag with poor durability.
It can be used as a temporary sleeping location, but it is removed after being used once.

[color=#ffff00][b]Sleeping Bag (Advanced Model)[/b][/color]
A more expensive but durable sleeping bag that can be used repeatedly.
When you sleep in this model, the location is remembered as your sleeping location. If you later pass out, you can wake up at the sleeping bag instead of automatically returning home, as long as the sleeping bag is still in the same location.

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Adds two types of portable sleeping bags.[/*]
[*]Can be placed both indoors and outdoors.[/*]
[*]Sleep by interacting with a placed sleeping bag.[/*]
[*]The Budget Model is removed after one use.[/*]
[*]The Advanced Model can be used repeatedly and remembers your sleeping location.[/*]
[*]Sleeping location data is preserved when saving and reloading the game.[/*]
[*]Sleeping bags cannot be placed in dungeon locations such as the Mines, Skull Cavern, Quarry Mine, and Volcano Dungeon.[/*]
[*]Available in multiple colors.[/*]
[*]Can be obtained through crafting or purchased from Robin's shop.[/*]
[*]Prices, crafting requirements, recipe unlock conditions, colors, and texture saturation can be customized through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size][/color]
The following options can be configured:
[list]
[*]Sleeping bag color[/*]
[*]Purchase price[/*]
[*]Crafting recipe unlock condition[/*]
[*]Amount of Cloth required for crafting[/*]
[*]Amount of Fiber required for crafting[/*]
[*]Texture saturation[/*]
[/list]The Budget Model and Advanced Model can be configured separately.
Recipe unlock conditions can be changed between starting with the recipe already available and unlocking it at specific Foraging levels.
Please note that if you change the recipe unlock condition during gameplay, the new setting will take effect the next day. Once a recipe has been learned, changing the setting will not remove it.

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Languages[/b][/size][/color]
This mod includes i18n files for:
[list]
[*]English (default)[/*]
[*]Japanese[/*]
[/list][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]T's Core 1.8.3 or later[/*]
[/list]T's Core is required for the custom sleeping, multi-tile collision, and placement features used by this mod.

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size][/color]
The Advanced Model remembers the location and position where it was last used for sleeping.
If the sleeping bag is removed or moved somewhere else, that location will no longer be treated as a valid sleeping location.
Placing the same type of sleeping bag again at the same position will make that position valid again.
The game's normal location restrictions still apply when determining whether the player can return to a saved sleeping location.
